steps.what: Select materials and supplies by checking content, edition, accessibility and course needs
Enter selected material particulars into the requisition draft
Verify and submit the requisition, then check that the correct materials arrive

tasks.design: Configure catalogue reuse in {PROCUREMENT} to populate a requisition from the teacher's checked selection. Retain academic selection, request verification and receipt checks; purchasing and supplier execution keep their own work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some selected item details were repeatedly copied into requisitions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue and saved-request fields can reuse explicit item particulars.
tasks.still_hard: Content suitability, edition differences and accessibility cannot be inferred from an item code.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher judges how a text represents perspectives and whether it serves the course.
tasks.altitude: A small amount of requisition entry time returns to checking material suitability.

reach.task: Specify the correct edition and accessible format for a course resource

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native catalogue reuse can populate requisition drafts; the digest supplies no measured teaching-material procurement saving.

assumptions: Boundary covers the teacher's selection, requisition and receipt checking, excluding purchasing approval, supplier fulfilment and invoice processing. No outside labour is removed.

The teacher produces counted s1 fields: title or item identifier, edition, format, quantity, verified supplier, price, course, cost centre and required date. Suppliers produce catalogue or quote particulars before verification; missing codes or unusual editions require manual requisition entry. Delivery status is supplied by purchasing or the supplier after fulfilment and is checked in counted s3, never assumed before submission.
Test native catalogue and saved-request configuration before custom software; existing automatic population earns no labour credit.
Six incremental focal hours cover catalogue and mapping checks; two other-role hours cover configuration upkeep.
unknowns: Existing catalogue coverage and manual entry
research_questions: Does catalogue reuse reduce entry while preserving edition, format and quantity accuracy?

steps.what: Perform administrative duties by reviewing department needs and directing priorities and responsibilities

tasks.enabler_now: Current administrative records support context without replacing leadership.
tasks.still_hard: Resource conflicts and sensitive concerns require negotiation and accountability.
tasks.human_edge: The head understands consequences across people and commitments.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in department authority or assumed leadership time.

reach.task: Discuss programme priorities under resource constraints

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: substantive department administration retains human leadership time; no particular repeat clerical baseline is established.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's department leadership, excluding HR, finance and programme-office execution and separate committee membership.

The head verifies obligations and resource information and elicits staff concerns during counted s1. Record owners supply source information; missing context requires manual clarification rather than a presumed priority or capacity flag.
Use existing administrative and project views before custom tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or reporting obligation is proposed.

steps.what: Review committee papers concerning institutional policies, department matters and academic issues
Serve on committees by discussing proposals and contributing to collective decisions

tasks.design: Keep committee preparation and deliberation with the teacher, using the current papers in {DOCS}. Summaries do not replace accountable review of proposals or participation in collective decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Proposals require interpretation of consequences and competing institutional interests.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document access supports preparation without establishing faster responsible review.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous policy wording and disagreement require careful consideration.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher brings disciplinary perspective and challenges assumptions during deliberation.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in committee responsibility or assumed time.

reach.task: Assess how a proposal affects programme outcomes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: committee review and deliberation retain human time; summaries do not establish equivalent governance participation.

assumptions: Boundary is committee membership, excluding secretariat minutes, document production and department-head execution of decisions.

The committee secretariat produces the agenda and proposal versions before review. The teacher checks them during counted s1; member contributions arrive during s2 rather than being assumed available beforehand.
Use native document sharing before custom briefing or decision tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because no automated process or additional committee record is introduced.
research_questions: Is there distinct duplicate administrative preparation outside substantive paper review?

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research

steps.what: Supervise student teaching, internship and research work through observation, feedback and contextual guidance

tasks.design: Retain personal supervision with existing {DOCS} work and {EMAIL} context. The teacher examines actual progress, gives feedback and helps the student decide appropriate next steps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Progress and support needs are not fully represented by task-completion records.
tasks.enabler_now: Current work samples support supervision without replacing observation and dialogue.
tasks.still_hard: Research uncertainty, placement difficulties and uneven independence require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognizes when to challenge a student and when to provide closer support.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in supervisory responsibility or assumed time.

reach.task: Support a student's reflection on teaching practice

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: substantive student supervision retains human time; no equivalent automated coaching outcome is established.

assumptions: Boundary is supervision, excluding student execution, separately assigned grading and placement-office administration.

Students and placement mentors produce work and context before or during the meeting. The teacher verifies progress and clarifies missing facts during counted s1; no pre-existing competence or risk flag substitutes for review.
Use native document sharing and communication before custom progress-monitoring tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or reporting obligation is introduced.
